quote: Richard J. McIntosh formulated the conjecture that there are infinitely many Wolstenholme primes in 1995, published in 'On the converse of Wolstenholme's theorem', Acta Arithmetica, Vol. 71, No. 4, pp. 381-389
note: Wolstenholme's original theorem dates to 1862, but the specific conjecture about infinitely many Wolstenholme primes was first formulated by McIntosh in 1995
